name: Exilium
source:
On Adastra, Alexios’s fate is chosen. He will not be directly executed but will instead be exiled from Adastra and sent out into space in an escape pod. Hopefully landing on a planet somewhere on random or be picked up by a vessel. He has the luck of landing on a planet. This being Earth. With limited knowledge of Marco’s homeworld, he begins to carefully explore while trying to stay clear of authorities and being exposed for being the alien that he is. Trying desperately to find a way to make it back to Adastra. He tries to build some sort of vessel from materials on Earth. If he makes it or not is up to you as the game has multiple endings being the results of the choices you make in-game.

[From [url=https://aexael-studios.itch.io/exilium]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在阿达斯特拉，阿莱克修斯的命运已被选择。他不会被直接处决，而是会被从阿达斯特拉放逐，并通过逃生舱送入太空。希望随机降落在行星上的某个地方或被飞船接走。他有幸降落在一个星球上。这就是地球。由于对马可的家乡了解有限，他开始仔细探索，同时试图远离当局并暴露自己是外星人。拼命寻找返回阿达斯特拉的方法。他试图用地球上的材料建造某种船只。他是否成功取决于你，因为游戏有多个结局，这是你在游戏中做出的选择的结果。

[来自[url=https://aexael-studios.itch.io/exilium]Itch.io[/url]]
